realEvents.title: Real events
realEvents.intro: Publish a completed event as a short editorial gallery on Vendora. Becomes social proof on your profile + a discoverable page that ranks for the event type and city. Only public after you confirm the host has given consent.
realEvents.emptyBody: One real-event page does more for you than ten static portfolio shots — hosts get to see the full arc of an evening.
realEvents.editorIntro: Tell the story of the evening. Fields auto-save when you tap Save; published events show up at /real-events/{{slug}}.
realEvents.titlePlaceholder: Sarah & Marcus, a brownstone garden wedding
realEvents.introPlaceholder: An intimate 60-guest celebration on a perfect October evening.
realEvents.storyPlaceholder: A few paragraphs about the day — the design vision, the moments that mattered, what made the event special.
realEvents.consentBody: Confirm the host is OK with this event being published publicly. Required before publish.

hostReputation.flaggedWarning_one: {{count}} other vendor flagged this host. Consider asking for a deposit upfront.
hostReputation.flaggedWarning_other: {{count}} other vendors flagged this host. Consider asking for a deposit upfront.
hostReputation.flagIntro: Your flag is private to you and rolls up into the host's cross-vendor signals. Use both positive and negative — the kudos help great hosts stand out.

bundles.title: Bundles
bundles.intro: Multi-vendor packages — partner with other vendors and offer combined pricing.
bundles.deleteBody: "{{name}}" will be removed from your offerings. This cannot be undone.
bundles.partialMatch_one: Saved, but {{count}} partner name didn't match an existing vendor.
bundles.partialMatch_other: Saved, but {{count}} partner names didn't match an existing vendor.
bundles.descriptionPlaceholder: Includes 8 hours photo + 6 hours video, edited gallery + highlight reel.
bundles.partnersHint: Exact name match required. You're auto-included as the lead.
bundles.activeHint: Show this bundle on your public profile.

referrals.title: Refer a vendor
referrals.intro: Invite another vendor — when they sign up + book their first event, you both get 1% off commission for life. (Live once payments ship.)
referrals.dialogBody: We'll generate a unique link tied to your vendor profile. When they sign up + book their first event, you both get 1% off your platform commission.
referrals.linkCopiedSend: Referral link copied — send it to your contact
referrals.emptyBody: No referrals sent yet. Refer 3 vendors → 3% off commission for life if they all book.

showcaseClips.title: Showcase clips
showcaseClips.intro: Short vertical videos (15-60s, max 30 MB) — first dance, the cake reveal, a venue at sunset. Hosts swipe through them on your profile.
showcaseClips.emptyBody: A 30-second highlight is worth more than a paragraph. Upload 2-3 to start.

recommendations.title: Vendors you recommend
recommendations.intro: Curate a short list of vendors you've worked with — surfaces on your public profile as "Vendors we love"
recommendations.emptyBody: Hosts trust referrals more than ranked listings. Add 3–5 vendors you'd vouch for.
recommendations.dialogBody: Pick a vendor to vouch for, optionally add a short note.
recommendations.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, category, or city
recommendations.notePlaceholder: Worked with them on three weddings — always on time, beautiful eye for color.

reviewRequests.title: Review requests
reviewRequests.intro: Send past clients a link they can use to leave a review — no account needed on their side.
reviewRequests.created: Request created — copy the link to send it
reviewRequests.dialogBody: Creates a unique review link for one client. Copy it from the list and paste into your email or text — no account required on their end.

shareKit.title: Share kit
shareKit.intro: Drop this on a business card, in your Instagram bio, or in an email signature — the QR scans straight to your Vendora profile.
